SEO Basics Package $2950

You're looking for a website with SEO basics, and you've found the right place. On this site, you can get a custom website with SEO basics, contact forms, and up to 5 pages for a one-time fee of $2,950, with a 50% deposit and the balance due at launch.

How it Works

The SEO Basics Package includes a custom design, up to 5 pages, and basic SEO setup. You'll get a website that is optimized for search engines, with a design that fits your brand. The process takes about a week, and you'll own the site outright, with no monthly fees for hosting on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub. You'll also get 90 days of free care after launch.

What You Get and Costs

The SEO Basics Package costs $2,950, with a 50% deposit due upfront and the balance due at launch. You'll get a custom website with up to 5 pages, basic SEO setup, and contact forms. After 90 days, you can opt for a care plan at $295/month or $595/month, which you can cancel at any time.

FAQ

What if I'm not happy with the design? You can get a free homepage remake with no obligation, and if you don't like it, you can keep the design. How long does it take to launch a website? The process takes about a week. Do I own the website? Yes, you own the website outright, including the code, content, and domain.

Get started with the SEO Basics Package
